claim: On November 15, 2023 Step Functions started to let you redrive Standard workflow executions from their point of failure.
question: When did redrive (restart failed workflows from the point of failure) launch?
note: d017. Current-truth facts: step-functions-redrivable-period, step-functions-redrive-standard-from-failed-step. Older exam questions may assume a failed execution must be started again from the beginning. Executions started before this date are not eligible for redrive.
